Dear Larkspur team,

I hope you're all doing well. I've been meaning to get back to you about the Wexcombe Regent for a client event we're hosting. We're really looking forward to it, and I'm sure it will be something special with the right venue. We need it on 04/07/2027, from 12:30 until 19:30, so I just wanted to confirm the details with you. We'll collect it from your garage as per usual. I've attached my driving licence, just in case. 

Thanks,
Bram Braithwell
